description: Defines fixed-size structures and associated methods for HTTP/2 protocol frames and fields, including headers, priority, reset, settings, push promise, ping, go away, window update, and other HTTP/2 frame structures.

classes.name: Http2FrameHeader
classes.description: Represents the header of an HTTP/2 frame, including payload length, stream ID, type, and flags, with methods for flag manipulation and string representation.

classes.name: Http2PriorityFields
classes.description: Represents the priority fields of an HTTP/2 stream, including stream dependency, weight, and exclusivity flag.

classes.name: Http2RstStreamFields
classes.description: Represents the RST_STREAM frame's error code in HTTP/2.

classes.name: Http2SettingFields
classes.description: Represents a SETTINGS parameter and its value in HTTP/2.

classes.name: Http2PushPromiseFields
classes.description: Represents the promised stream ID in a PUSH_PROMISE frame.

classes.name: Http2PingFields
classes.description: Represents the opaque bytes in a PING frame.

classes.name: Http2GoAwayFields
classes.description: Represents the last stream ID and error code in a GOAWAY frame.

classes.name: Http2WindowUpdateFields
classes.description: Represents the window size increment in a WINDOW_UPDATE frame.

classes.name: Http2AltSvcFields
classes.description: Represents the fixed size portion of an ALTSVC frame payload.

classes.name: Http2PriorityUpdateFields
classes.description: Represents the stream ID whose priority is being updated.

methods.name: EncodedSize
methods.description: Returns the size in bytes of the encoded structure.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the structure for debugging.

methods.name: IsSupportedErrorCode
methods.description: Checks if the error code is supported in HTTP/2.

methods.name: IsSupportedHttp2ErrorCode
methods.description: External function to check if an error code is supported.

methods.name: IsSupportedHttp2SettingsParameter
methods.description: External function to check if a settings parameter is supported.

methods.name: StreamIdMask
methods.description: External constant/macro for stream ID bitmask.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: External function to convert structures to string.
